summary.problem: Calling Vertex AI or Gemini API through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy throws 'TypeError: HttpsProxyAgent is not a constructor'.
summary.root_cause: esbuild ESM bundling with code splitting causes dynamic import('https-proxy-agent') inside gaxios to lose named exports and resolve HttpsProxyAgent to undefined.
summary.context: Statically importing HttpProxyAgent and HttpsProxyAgent in contentGenerator.ts and injecting the pre-instantiated agent via googleAuthOptions.clientOptions.transporterOptions.agent bypasses gaxios's dynamic import path entirely.

steps: Statically import HttpProxyAgent from 'http-proxy-agent' and HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent' in packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts.
In createContentGenerator, extract and trim the proxy URL from config if present.
Instantiate HttpProxyAgent if baseUrl starts with 'http://', otherwise instantiate HttpsProxyAgent.
Inject proxyAgent into GoogleGenAI constructor options via googleAuthOptions.clientOptions.transporterOptions.agent.
Add http-proxy-agent dependency to packages/core/package.json and root package.json.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: GoogleGenAI constructor receives transporterOptions.agent set to HttpsProxyAgent for HTTPS destinations and HttpProxyAgent for HTTP destinations when a proxy is configured, and omits googleAuthOptions when no proxy is configured.
verification_steps: Verify HttpsProxyAgent injection when proxy URL is configured with HTTPS destination.
Verify HttpProxyAgent injection when destination baseUrl uses http:// protocol.
Verify trimming of leading/trailing whitespace from proxy URL string before agent creation.
Verify googleAuthOptions is omitted when no proxy URL is configured.

github_metadata.title: fix(core): externalize https-proxy-agent to fix proxy support
